name: Orrery
description: A live, OLED-black solar system as your wallpaper: planets in their real positions, spinning at their relative speeds, with the spacecraft of the space age replaying their gravity-assist journeys and fact cards about distances, speeds and the worlds themselves. Moons, asteroids, comets and Lagrange points, planned missions into the 2030s, ambient music, and the overview shows it too. Click anything to pin a card, scrub through history on the timeline, and switch to a sunlight view.
